name: Protect
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate protector of His people, providing refuge, strength, and deliverance in times of trouble, as seen in Psalms 32:7 and 46:1. He commands His angels to guard believers in all their ways (Psalms 91:11) and promises to uphold them with His righteous hand (Isaiah 41:10). Furthermore, God assures that no weapon formed against His servants will succeed and that He alone will execute justice, calling His people to trust Him rather than seek personal vengeance (Isaiah 54:17; Romans 12:19).
